process() returns error with empty language name

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { language: "" };
try {
    process("x = 1", config);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
